statements.statement: The patient presents with intermittent episodes of palpitations
The patient presents with episodes of dizziness and giddiness
These symptoms have persisted despite initial evaluation
Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was ordered
The service was ordered for extended ambulatory assessment
The service is medically necessary to characterize the arrhythmia
The service is medically necessary to correlate reported symptoms with cardiac rhythm disturbances observed during monitoring
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial is based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
Diagnosis codes R00.2 and R42 were submitted
